visual: Hot neon-pink cactus blooms · glossy mahogany-black foliage · compact habit
water: Keep evenly moist in active growth
soilWarning: Avoid winter wet · protect tubers from frost
prune: Deadhead regularly; cut down after first frost
toxicity: Mildly toxic to dogs and cats if eaten · may cause dermatitis
cvs: trade name ELECTRO PINK; RHS cultivar code '71853-09'; EU PBR denomination 'EP7185309'
hardinessNote: Breeder minimum about -6°C maps to H4; protect tubers in UK winter
uncertain: RHS uses cultivar code '71853-09' while EU PBR material uses 'EP7185309' for the same plant
Exact mature-size sources range from about 50 cm to roughly 80 cm tall
